senses.definition: the fifth pillar of Islam is a pilgrimage to Mecca during the month of Dhu al-Hijja; at least once in a lifetime a Muslim is expected to make a religious journey to Mecca and the Kaaba
examples: for a Muslim the hajj is the ultimate act of worship

senses.definition: an Arabic term of respect for someone who has made the pilgrimage to Mecca
